When is it Time to Replace Your Furnace or Heat Pump?
Look out for these problem signs in your furnace:

items: Strange noises: The number one red flag is when your furnace or heat pump becomes too noisy. It may be true that all furnaces are not going to be quiet, but it is also not normal for your furnace to be making unusual sounds for an extended period of time. If you hear groaning, banging, or whining noises it may be time to contact our professionals for an assessment.

Old age: A furnace usually lasts anywhere between 10 to 20 years. Most heating systems will last to the upper end of that range. If your furnace is more than 15 years old, you may need to start planning on replacing it.

Frequent repairs: If your heating system requires regular repair, this could signal that it is time to replace the unit. Eventually, the cost for consistent repairs could outweigh the cost of a furnace replacement. Our heating company will be able to work with you to choose a unit that accommodates your needs and budget.

Rising energy bills: Furnaces & Heat Pumps often lose efficiency when they age. This is especially true if the furnace is not properly maintained. Rising gas and electricity bills also mean that your furnace may have to run longer to provide the same amount of heat. This, in turn, can lead to higher energy bills.

Fluctuating temperatures: If you are constantly fiddling with your thermostat to keep comfortable, this could be a warning sign that your furnace or heat pump is losing efficiency. Inconsistent temperatures point directly to your furnace failing to properly distribute the air in your home.
